name: worldkeep
description: Worldkeep: capture and view a structured worldbuilding canon

interface.longDescription: Turn natural-language worldbuilding into a structured, approval-gated Markdown/YAML canon. Review the meanings the agent modeled, validate consistency, and refine configurable offline graph views.
defaultPrompt: Help me capture this worldbuilding into canon.
Render a graph of my worldbuilding canon.
Help me review my canon's semantics and create a meaningful custom view.
